components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The site's only filled CTA color. Used for every WhatsApp order action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background-color: #e8927c; color: #201c1a; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 24px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #d07660; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #201c1a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-icon { flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline/ghost pill for the second action on a screen (never a second fill color).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: transparent; color: #201c1a; border: 1px solid #e4e2df; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 24px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #f3f2f0; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #201c1a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Pinterest pin-card pattern: full-bleed image, overlay pill badge, flat meta below, CTA pinned to the bottom of the card regardless of title/price length.
components.html:
Baru

Buket Tulip Import

components.css: .ds-product-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; background-color: #f3f2f0; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-product-media { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4/5; overflow: hidden; } .ds-product-img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 0.3s; } .ds-product-card:hover .ds-product-img { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-product-badge { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 12px; background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); color: #201c1a; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-product-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; padding: 16px; } .ds-product-text { flex: 1; } .ds-product-title { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: #201c1a; } .ds-product-price { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 14px; color: #6b6660; } .ds-product-cta { width: 100%; margin-top: 12px; }

components.name: Nav Capsule
components.description: Floating pill navigation, sticky below the viewport top, reads as an object sitting on the page rather than a docked bar.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-nav-capsule { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; background-color: rgba(250,250,249,0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border: 1px solid #e4e2df; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-nav-logo { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; color: #201c1a; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 4px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-nav-links a { display: block; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #201c1a; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { background-color: #f3f2f0; }

components.name: Signature Stat Card
components.description: The one full-bleed dark punctuation card on a page (e.g. the '35 Kota' section) - inverts ink/gallery-white, used sparingly.
components.html:
35 Kota

Pengiriman flower, cake, dan gift ke 35 kota se-Indonesia.
components.css: .ds-signature-card { background-color: #201c1a; color: #fafaf9; border-radius: 32px; padding: 48px 32px; text-align: center; } .ds-signature-stat { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 48px; } .ds-signature-copy { margin: 12px auto 0; max-width: 28ch; color: rgba(250,250,249,0.8); }

narrative.overview: Blume & Co. reads like a beloved corner florist that happens to ship to 35 cities: warm, a little playful, hand-picked-feeling, but organized with the discipline of a real national catalog. The canvas is a clean off-white gallery wall, not a rustic cream paper stock, so the two brand accents (marigold gold and living coral) and the pastel category tints (blossom pink, lilac mist) read as deliberate pops of personality rather than blending into a uniformly warm haze. Cards and content blocks are playful and full of energy, not restrained; the CTA (a solid coral pill) is unmistakably the one thing to press on any given screen. The system is a deliberate hybrid of three references, each owning a different job: Pinterest supplies the floating capsule navigation and the pin-card product grid; Notion supplies the pastel-tint grouping used to visually cluster related items; Airtable supplies the section pacing and the signature full-bleed dark stat card that punctuates the page rhythm.
keyCharacteristics: Clean off-white base (never cream/beige) with two confident brand accents, not a diffuse warm palette
Playful, energetic card treatment; CTAs are the loudest element on any screen
Pastel tints group content (Notion), never decorate it
One full-pill / one soft / one signature radius, applied by strict role, never mixed within a role
Flat by default; shadow appears only on things that float above the page

rules.name: The One-CTA-Color Rule
rules.body: Living Coral is the only filled button color on the entire site. A second button on a screen is an outline/ghost button in Espresso Ink, never a second filled color. Exception: on a Living-Coral-background section (e.g. the closing CTA band), the button flips to white fill with Espresso Ink text for contrast.

rules.name: The Tint-Never-Text Rule
rules.body: Blossom Pink and Lilac Mist appear only as low-opacity backgrounds/gradients for grouping. Neither ever carries foreground text or an emphasis border.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section headings stand alone. No small uppercase-tracked kicker label above a headline.

rules.name: The Floats-Get-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If an element is pinned/overlaid/fixed above other content, it gets shadow-lg. If it sits in normal document flow, it stays flat and relies on background-color contrast instead.

rules.name: The Role-Locked Radius Rule
rules.body: Radius is assigned by what the element is (button vs. card vs. signature block), never by taste on a given screen. A button is always full-pill; a card is always 16px.

dos: Do keep Living Coral as the only filled-button color, everywhere, always.
Do use tonal layering (Gallery White / Warm Fog / Whisper White) to separate sections instead of adding borders or shadow.
Do keep every dropdown, card, and grid on the four-radius lock (8 / 16 / 32 / full) - no arbitrary radius values.
Do let pastel tints (Blossom Pink, Lilac Mist, Marigold Gold-at-low-opacity) group content, and stop there.
Do break up any run of 3+ identically-sized cards/tiles with an asymmetric or staggered treatment instead of a flat equal grid.
donts: Don't use white text on Living Coral or Marigold Gold - both fail contrast; Espresso Ink is the only text color that works on either.
Don't introduce a second neutral-base family (no cream, no beige, no warm paper) - Gallery White is the one and only background.
Don't add an eyebrow/kicker label above a section heading.
Don't let a large product/city grid render unbounded - reveal the first 12 and disclose the rest.
Don't use emoji anywhere in UI copy or headings.
